title_en: Reply of the Supreme People's Procuratorate on Whether It Is Illegal to Take Criminal Detention Coercive Measures Against a Minor Suspected of Theft Under the Age of 16

articles.content_en:
Supreme People's Procuratorate
January 25, 2011
Supreme People's Procuratorate
Official Reply on Whether the Compulsory Measure of Criminal Detention Taken Against Minors Under the Age of 16 Suspected of Theft Is Illegal
(Adopted at the 54th Session of the Eleventh Procuratorial Committee of the Supreme People's Procuratorate on January 10, 2011)
Gao Jian Fa Shi Zi [2011] No. 1
Beijing Municipal People's Procuratorate:
Your Request (Jing Jian Zi [2010] No. 107) on "Whether the Compulsory Measure of Criminal Detention Taken Against Minors Under the Age of 16 Suspected of Theft Is Illegal" has been received. Upon study, the reply is as follows:
According to the provisions of the Criminal Law, Criminal Procedure Law, Law on the Protection of Minors, and other relevant laws, for a minor under the age of 16 at the time of committing a crime, and who has not committed the crime specified in Article 17, paragraph 2 of the Criminal Law, if after the public security organ ascertains that the criminal suspect's age at the time of committing the crime is indeed under 16 and he or she is not criminally liable according to law, but still imposes criminal detention, the procuratorial organ shall promptly issue corrective opinions.
This is the reply.
Supreme People's Procuratorate
January 25, 2011
